items.title: Canonical exact-pair diagnosis previously admitted ambiguous benchmark bundles
items.summary: Exact-pair benchmark diagnosis used to admit incomplete selected/base hash bundles and contradictory runtime overrides, which could let non-canonical experiments look like product behavior.
items.exitCriteria: Exact-pair diagnosis fails closed on incomplete selected/base pairs and contradictory proof-admission override bundles before any retained evidence is generated.

items.title: Explicit Windows runtime bundles previously allowed contradictory runtime-bitness contamination
items.summary: PROGRAM-0003 entrypoints could accept explicit Windows runtime override bundles that contradicted the selected runtime bitness, weakening future benchmark and diagnosis truth.
items.exitCriteria: Shared runtime-override validation rejects explicit Windows bundles that contradict the selected runtime bitness while still admitting the canonical x86 LabVIEWCLI plus selected x86/x64 LabVIEW 2026 host bundle.

items.title: Windows pair-129 benchmark ceiling is an accepted bounded exception for the current governed image contract
items.summary: The accepted cross-OS comparable prefix remains bounded at `129` commits / `128` pairs because the current governed Windows benchmark image contract exposes only a mixed-bitness `labview-cli` surface at pair `129`: x86 `LabVIEWCLI.exe` exists beside x64 `LabVIEW.exe`, no coherent same-bitness `labview-cli` bundle is present in the current image contract, and the exact-pair blocker is retained as `mixed-bitness-call-by-reference-seam`. Out-of-scope alternative provisioning may install x86 LabVIEW through slower NI Package Manager plus ISO steps, but that is a different contract and does not reopen the accepted bounded ceiling here.
items.discoveredContext: PROGRAM-0003 comparable-prefix proof and exact-pair Windows diagnosis
items.nextGate: Reopen this exception only if the governed Windows benchmark image contract changes to provide a coherent same-bitness `labview-cli` bundle or another in-scope Windows benchmark provider becomes the accepted authority surface.
items.exitCriteria: Keep the accepted pair-129 ceiling explicit until the governed Windows benchmark image contract itself changes; do not treat out-of-scope alternative provisioning as current benchmark truth.
items.acceptedExceptionRationale: The current governed Windows benchmark image contract is now machine-readably retained as a mixed-bitness-only `labview-cli` surface, so pair `129` is no longer an unresolved open benchmark debt inside that contract. Reopening it would require an approved contract change, not another rerun against the same image recipe.

items.title: Linux pair-135 full-window benchmark ceiling is an accepted bounded exception for the current governed Linux contract
items.summary: The Linux deep `HARNESS-VHS-002` window remains bounded at pair `135/138`. A fresh governed canonical-host rerun on 2026-04-06 still failed there as `labview-cli-connection-failed` with retained diagnostic reason `linux-headless-recursive-load`, and the governed `CloseLabVIEW -Headless` recovery attempt exited `1` before retry. The accepted cross-OS benchmark truth therefore remains the retained `129`-commit / `128`-pair comparable-prefix packet rather than the full Linux window.
items.nextGate: Reopen this exception only if the governed NI Linux runtime/benchmark-image contract changes enough to justify a new full-window proof attempt, or another in-scope Linux benchmark provider becomes the accepted authority surface.
items.exitCriteria: Keep the pair-135 full-window ceiling explicit while the retained `129`-commit / `128`-pair comparable-prefix packet remains the accepted cross-OS timing scope; do not treat repeated reruns against the same current Linux contract as unresolved open debt.
items.acceptedExceptionRationale: The current governed Linux full-window blocker is now freshly retained under the canonical-host/AppData rerun path with the current recovery posture. Because the same contract still fails at pair `135/138` after one governed `CloseLabVIEW -Headless` reset and retry, keeping PROGRAM-0003 notionally open would blur bounded benchmark truth with vendor/runtime churn. Reopening requires a contract change or a new accepted Linux provider, not another rerun against the same current contract.

items.title: Synthesized effective proof-admission bundles previously bypassed canonical admission control
items.summary: PROGRAM-0003 benchmark entrypoints could synthesize an explicit effective proof-admission bundle from CLI arguments, environment variables, and entrypoint-local defaults after raw CLI validation had already passed, weakening canonical admission truth.
items.exitCriteria: Benchmark-proof entrypoints validate the effective proof-admission bundle after CLI/env/default synthesis, and no hidden explicit Windows runtime executable default is injected when the operator did not request an explicit override.

items.title: Historical Docker-only execution and acquisition transparency closeout
items.summary: The retired `TRANCHE-013` / `ISSUE-0410` Docker-only installed-contract debt remains retained as historical baseline evidence: it removed `executionMode`, hidden host-runtime knobs, public image settings, and implicit acquisition-state truth from the earlier installed compare workflow. It is not the current installed-user runtime destination. Current branch truth is the published host-default local `LabVIEWCLI` provider plus bounded expert Docker path governed by `TRANCHE-016` / `ISSUE-0412` / `ADR-0038`, while `DEBT-0006` only preserves why the older Docker-only transparency debt was considered retired.
items.discoveredContext: Post-release execution-flexibility and contamination-safe runtime UX planning
items.exitCriteria: Retain `DEBT-0006` only as the historical Docker-only transparency closeout: the repo no longer presents `TRANCHE-013` / `ISSUE-0410` as the active installed runtime destination, current control-plane and reader surfaces point to `TRANCHE-016` / `ISSUE-0412` / `ADR-0038` for host-default local `LabVIEWCLI` plus bounded expert Docker, and tests fail if the debt ledger reintroduces current-sounding Docker-only destination language.
